<observation>Reviewed the screenshot as a QA reviewer for visual defects. Scanned text legibility, component geometry, occlusion, image-meaning alignment, and chart-meaning consistency. All visible text is fully legible with no cutoff or compression. No components are stretched, skewed, or overflowing. No overlapping elements obscure necessary content. The red mug image matches its label “빨간 머그” and quantity/price. The bar chart’s percentages (80% 노트, 20% 머그) visually match the relative bar lengths. No ambiguous or conflicting visual evidence found. No issue detected under any criterion.</observation>
